data.assumption: “तमिलनाडु के Q2 के आंकड़े” को मैंने 2026 की कैलेंडर Q2 अवधि में तमिलनाडु के रोज़ाना सफल payment amount और successful payment attempts के रूप में माना है।
data.sql:
SELECT pa.business_date, SUM(pa.amount_minor) AS successful_payment_amount_minor, COUNT(*) AS successful_payment_attempts
FROM payment_attempts pa
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = pa.order_id
JOIN showrooms s ON s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = s.region_id AND r.country_code = s.country_code
WHERE pa.is_test = false
  AND o.is_test = false
  AND pa.status = 'succeeded'
  AND r.name = 'Tamil Nadu'
  AND pa.business_date >= DATE '2026-04-01'
  AND pa.business_date < DATE '2026-07-01'
  AND pa.currency = 'INR'
GROUP BY pa.business_date
ORDER BY pa.business_date
